captured_from: wicked-estate-mcp-0.35.x (anydoc-convert: +path, chunks optional when path is given; additive)
description: Ingest a document as doc + chunk nodes. Give the text as `chunks`, or give `path` to a local binary document (pdf, doc/docx, ppt/pptx, xls/xlsx, odt/odp/ods, rtf, epub): estate converts it to Markdown in-process (no network, no OCR) and chunks it at its H1/H2 headings; a scanned PDF is refused as needing OCR.

source.description: provenance, e.g. a file path or URL

path.description: a local binary document to convert instead of chunks

name: knowledge.ingest
